text.tspan: Prerequisites: configured fedavg.v1 space and memberships,
registered types, published global base and initialized main.
All clients use the same immutable base record ID.
Each starts from the shared global base.
Validate round manifest and supplied hashes.
Changed round or completed acquisition stops recovery.
Uncertain outcomes retain evidence for reconciliation.
An explicitly selected claim is never replaced.
Metadata failures reach the runner with saved ownership.
Confirmed abandon clears run-state, failed abandon retains it.
Check checkpoint compatibility and schema-2 hashes.
Require at least 2 valid checkpoints after filtering.
The owner launches aggregation, not the service.
